description: Structured eval definitions for the Client VPN Endpoint Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across auth modes (mutual TLS split-tunnel with custom DNS leak prevention, SAML federation with self-service portal, Active Directory full-tunnel, multi-rule authorization ordering verification, missing ACM server certificate prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Mutual TLS Client VPN with split-tunnel and custom DNS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — mutual TLS auth, split-tunnel with custom DNS server (leak prevention), single subnet association, allow-all authorization rule
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Client VPN endpoint in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Client CIDR 10.250.0.0/16. Mutual TLS auth using server certificate arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123. Split tunnel enabled. DNS server 10.0.0.2 (VPC resolver). Target VPC vpc-aaa11122 (10.0.0.0/16). Associate subnet subnet-aaa11122 in us-east-1a. Authorization rule: allow all groups to access 10.0.0.0/16. Connection logging to CloudWatch log group client-vpn-logs. Transport UDP on port 443. Tags: Environment=production, Access=corporate.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLIENT_VPN: cvpn-aaa11122bbbb3333 (10.250.0.0/16 → vpc-aaa11122)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Client CIDR: 10.250.0.0/16 (non-overlapping with 10.0.0.0/16)
  [✓] Authentication: mutual-TLS (ACM arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123)
  [✓] Authorization rules: 1 rule — allow all groups to 10.0.0.0/16
  [✓] Target subnet association: subnet-aaa11122 in us-east-1a — available
  [✓] DNS servers: 10.0.0.2 (split-tunnel DNS leak prevented)
  [✓] Tunnel mode: split-tunnel
  [✓] Transport protocol: udp (port 443)
  [✓] Connection logging: enabled (CloudWatch client-vpn-logs)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-client-vpn-endpoints --client-vpn-endpoint-ids cvpn-aaa11122bbbb3333 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SAML federated Client VPN with self-service portal
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SAML 2.0 federation auth, self-service portal enabled, full-tunnel mode
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Client VPN endpoint in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Client CIDR 10.250.0.0/16. SAML federated authentication using provider arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/CorporateIdP. Server certificate arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123 (required even for SAML). Enable self-service portal. Full-tunnel mode. DNS server 10.0.0.2. Target VPC vpc-aaa11122 (10.0.0.0/16). Associate subnet subnet-aaa11122. Authorization rule: allow all groups to access 10.0.0.0/16. Tags: Environment=production, Auth=federated.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLIENT_VPN: cvpn-ccc22233dddd4444 (10.250.0.0/16 → vpc-aaa11122)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Authentication: SAML federation (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/CorporateIdP)
  [✓] Self-service portal: enabled
  [✓] Tunnel mode: full-tunnel
  [✓] Target subnet association: subnet-aaa11122 in us-east-1a — available
  [✓] Authorization rules: 1 rule — allow all groups to 10.0.0.0/16

eval_cases.name: Active Directory Client VPN with full-tunnel
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Active Directory auth (AWS Managed AD), full-tunnel mode, group-restricted authorization rule
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Client VPN endpoint in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Client CIDR 10.251.0.0/16. Active Directory authentication using directory ID d-9067a4a4bd (AWS Managed Microsoft AD). Server certificate arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123. Full tunnel (no split-tunnel). DNS server 10.0.0.2. Target VPC vpc-bbb22233 (172.16.0.0/16). Associate subnet subnet-bbb22233 in us-east-1b. Authorization rule: allow group corp-users to access 172.16.0.0/16. Connection logging to CloudWatch log group client-vpn-ad-logs. Tags: Environment=production, Auth=active-directory.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLIENT_VPN: cvpn-eee33344ffff5555 (10.251.0.0/16 → vpc-bbb22233)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Authentication: Active Directory (d-9067a4a4bd)
  [✓] Tunnel mode: full-tunnel
  [✓] Target subnet association: subnet-bbb22233 in us-east-1b — available
  [✓] Authorization rules: 1 rule — group corp-users to 172.16.0.0/16
  [✓] Connection logging: enabled (CloudWatch client-vpn-ad-logs)

eval_cases.name: Client VPN with multi-rule authorization ordering verification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multiple authorization rules ordered specific-first, broad-last (first-match wins)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Client VPN endpoint in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Client CIDR 10.250.0.0/16. Mutual TLS auth using server certificate arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123. Split tunnel enabled. DNS server 10.0.0.2. Target VPC vpc-aaa11122 (10.0.0.0/16). Associate subnet subnet-aaa11122. Create TWO authorization rules: (1) allow group data-team to access 10.0.0.0/16, (2) allow all groups to access 0.0.0.0/0. Rule 1 must be evaluated before rule 2. Tags: Environment=production, Access=multi-rule.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLIENT_VPN: cvpn-ggg44455hhhh6666 (10.250.0.0/16 → vpc-aaa11122)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Authentication: mutual-TLS (ACM arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123)
  [✓] Authorization rules: 2 rules — first-match ordering verified (10.0.0.0/16 data-team first; 0.0.0.0/0 all-staff last)
  [✓] DNS servers: 10.0.0.2 (split-tunnel DNS leak prevented)
  [✓] Tunnel mode: split-tunnel

eval_cases.name: Client VPN mutual TLS without ACM server certificate (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — mutual TLS requires a server certificate in ACM; none provided
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Client VPN endpoint in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Client CIDR 10.250.0.0/16. Mutual TLS auth but no server certificate has been imported into ACM yet. Target VPC vpc-aaa11122 (10.0.0.0/16). Associate subnet subnet-aaa11122.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLIENT_VPN: (pending — cvpn-id not provisionable)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Server certificate: MISSING — mutual TLS auth requires a server certificate in ACM; import one before creating the endpoint
